info.name: Otto AI Backend v2
info.description:
API collection for Otto AI Backend - AI-powered Revenue Intelligence Platform

**Authentication:**
- All protected endpoints require a valid JWT access token in the Authorization header (Bearer token)
- Use POST /auth/signup or POST /auth/login to obtain access_token and refresh_token
- Use POST /auth/refresh to get a new access_token using your refresh_token
- Access tokens expire after a configured time (default: 15 minutes)
- Refresh tokens have a longer expiration (default: 7 days)

**Public Endpoints (No JWT required):**
- POST /auth/signup - Register new user
- POST /auth/login - Login with email/password
- POST /auth/refresh - Refresh access token
- POST /webhooks/* - Webhook endpoints (called by external services)
- GET /health - Health check

**Protected Endpoints (JWT required):**
- GET /auth/me - Get current user info
- GET /calls - List calls (requires EXECUTIVE or CSR role)
- GET /calls/{call_id} - Get call by ID (requires EXECUTIVE or CSR role)
- GET /leads - List leads with filters (requires EXECUTIVE or CSR role)
- GET /leads/{lead_id} - Get lead by ID (requires EXECUTIVE or CSR role)
- GET /metrics/* - Metrics endpoints (various role requirements)
- POST /rag/ask-otto - Query Ask Otto (requires EXECUTIVE role)

variable.description: JWT access token - Obtained from /auth/signup or /auth/login. Required for all protected endpoints.
JWT refresh token - Obtained from /auth/signup or /auth/login. Use with /auth/refresh to get new access token.
Company UUID - will be populated after signup/login
Call UUID - will be populated after creating a call
Lead UUID - will be populated after retrieving a lead

item.name: Auth

request.description:
Register a new user account.

**Request Body:**
- `email` (required): User email address
- `password` (required, min 8 chars): User password
- `first_name` (optional): First name
- `last_name` (optional): Last name
- `role` (optional, default: sales_rep): User role (csr, sales_rep, executive)
- `company_id` (optional): Associated company UUID

**Response:**
Returns access_token, refresh_token, and user information. Tokens are automatically saved to collection variables.

Login with email and password.

**Request Body:**
- `email` (required): User email address
- `password` (required): User password

**Response:**
Returns access_token, refresh_token, and user information. Tokens are automatically saved to collection variables.

Refresh access token using refresh token.

**Request Body:**
- `refresh_token` (required): JWT refresh token obtained from signup/login

**Response:**
Returns a new access_token. The new token is automatically saved to collection variables.

Get current authenticated user information.

**Authentication:**
Requires valid JWT access token in Authorization header (Bearer token).

**Response:**
Returns current user information including id, email, role, company_id, etc.

item.description: Authentication endpoints for user registration, login, token refresh, and user info.

request.description:
List all calls for a specific company with pagination support.

**Authentication:**
Requires valid JWT access token. User must have EXECUTIVE or CSR role.

**Query Parameters:**
- `company_id` (required): UUID of the company to retrieve calls for
- `skip` (optional, default=0): Number of records to skip for pagination

Requires valid JWT access token. User must have EXECUTIVE or CSR role.

**Path Parameters:**
- `call_id` (required): UUID of the call to retrieve

item.name: Webhooks

header.description: Company UUID (can also be in payload)

request.description:
Webhook endpoint for telephony providers (CallRail, Twilio) to notify when a call is completed.

**Note:** This endpoint does NOT require JWT authentication as it's called by external services. For production, implement webhook signature verification.

**Request Body:**
- `company_id` (required): Company UUID (can also be in X-Company-Id header)
- `phone_number` (required): Phone number of the call
- `audio_url` (required): URL to the call audio recording
- `call_type` (required): Type of call (csr_call, sales_call, missed_call)
- `missed_call` (optional): Whether the call was missed
- `duration_seconds` (optional): Call duration in seconds

request.description:
Webhook endpoint for Shoonya to notify when an AI job (transcription, analysis) is completed.

**Note:** This endpoint does NOT require JWT authentication as it's called by external services. For production, implement webhook signature verification.

**Request Body:**
- `shunya_job_id` (required): Shoonya job identifier
- `status` (required): Job status (must be "completed")
- `call_id` (required): UUID of the call this analysis belongs to
- `company_id` (required): Company UUID (can also be in X-Company-Id header)
- `result` (required): Job result data containing:
  - `transcript` (optional): Call transcript text
  - `analysis` (required): Analysis data with:
    - `qualification_status` (optional): Qualification status string
    - `booking_status` (optional): Booking status string
    - `objections` (optional): Array of objection types (price, timing, authority, need, competitor, other)
    - `objection_texts` (optional): Array of objection detail texts
    - `sop_stages_completed` (optional): Array of completed SOP stages
    - `sop_stages_missed` (optional): Array of missed SOP stages
    - `sop_compliance_score` (optional): SOP compliance score (0-1)
    - `sentiment_score` (optional): Sentiment score (-1 to 1)
    - `summary` (optional): Call summary text
    - `key_points` (optional): Array of key points

**Response:**
Returns status, call_id, and analysis_id on success.

item.description: Webhook endpoints for external services (telephony providers, Shoonya). These endpoints do NOT require JWT authentication.

item.name: Leads

query.description: Filter by status (comma-separated, e.g., qualified_unbooked or closed_lost,abandoned,dormant)
Maximum number of records to return

request.description:
List leads for a company with optional filters.

**Authentication:**
Requires valid JWT access token. User must have EXECUTIVE or CSR role.

**Query Parameters:**
- `company_id` (required): Company UUID
- `status` (optional): Filter by status (comma-separated, e.g., "qualified_unbooked" or "closed_lost,abandoned,dormant")
- `nurturing` (optional): Filter nurturing leads (comma-separated, e.g., "new,warm,hot")
- `sort` (optional): Sort option (e.g., "priority")
- `skip` (optional, default=0): Number of records to skip
- `limit` (optional, default=100): Maximum number of records to return

**Examples:**
- Get qualified unbooked: `?company_id=...&status=qualified_unbooked`
- Get qualified booked: `?company_id=...&status=qualified_booked`
- Get closed/lost/abandoned: `?company_id=...&status=closed_lost,abandoned,dormant`
- Get nurturing leads: `?company_id=...&nurturing=new,warm,hot`
- Sort by priority: `?company_id=...&sort=priority`

Get lead by ID.

**Authentication:**
Requires valid JWT access token. User must have EXECUTIVE or CSR role.

**Path Parameters:**
- `lead_id` (required): Lead UUID

item.description: Lead management endpoints for listing and retrieving leads. Requires EXECUTIVE or CSR role.

item.name: Metrics

query.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to 30 days ago)

request.description:
Get company overview metrics within date range.

**Authentication:**
Requires valid JWT access token. User must have EXECUTIVE role.

**Query Parameters:**
- `company_id` (required): Company UUID
- `start_date` (optional): Start date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to 30 days ago)
- `end_date` (optional): End date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today)

**Response:**
Returns total leads, active leads, calls, missed calls, appointments, conversion rate, and total revenue.

item.name: RAG / Ask Otto

request.description:
Query Ask Otto (RAG-based AI copilot) for intelligent insights from call data.

**Authentication:**
Requires valid JWT access token. User must have EXECUTIVE role and be associated with a company.

**Request Body:**
- `query` (required): The question or query to ask Otto
- `context` (optional): Additional context for the query (date ranges, filters, etc.)

**Response:**
Returns AI-generated answer based on call data analysis.
